posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-device-info 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。只读的 Windows 设备信息工具：每个 Win32 设备类别一个 agent 工具（时间、系统、CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、网络、电池、进程、USB、音频、打印机），基于 WMI/CIM 与 Node os 采集。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-206c65bd7e72641c16c1.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-device-info is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Read-only Windows device information tools: one agent tool per Win32 device category (time, system, cpu, memory, disk, gpu, network, battery, processes, usb, audio, printers) via WMI/CIM and Node os collectors.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-206c65bd7e72641c16c1.html
